part2_note:
Note:
Carcinoma of cecum is listed in Part II because it caused anaemia and weakened the patient, but it did not cause arteriosclerotic heart disease. Congestive heart failure is also listed in Part II because it also weakened the patient. Although it was caused by the arteriosclerotic heart disease, it was not part of the causal sequence leading to the acute myocardial infarction.
